angularDiameterSource: Computed here from the record's radius and distance: 2 x 631,000 km at 64.59 pc = 0.13 mas. No interferometric diameter of this star is used.
distanceSource: Gaia DR3 parallax 15.4833 +/- 0.0108 mas (same row, RUWE 0.87): 64.59 pc, no zero-point correction
radiusSource: Radius 0.907 +/- 0.017 solar radii from Hua et al. 2023, the stellar radius of the default parameter set of TOI-784 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023AJ....166...32H/abstract): 631,000 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. Mass 0.91 +/- 0.1 solar masses from Hua et al. 2023, the stellar mass of the default parameter set of TOI-784 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023AJ....166...32H/abstract); GM is that mass times the JPL solar GM. Temperature 5558 +/- 100 K from Hua et al. 2023, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of TOI-784 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023AJ....166...32H/abstract). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.
effectiveTemperatureSource: Hua et al. 2023, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of TOI-784 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023AJ....166...32H/abstract)
surfaceGravitySource: log g from the mass and radius in packages/astronomy/data/bodies/toi-784.json (sources in its physicalNotes), log10(GM/R^2) in cgs: 4.482, rounded to two decimals
spectralTypeSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of HD 307842 (pscomppars): spectral type G, from Hua et al. 2023 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023AJ....166...32H/abstract)
objectTypeSource: SIMBAD, HD 307842: main object type PM*, High Proper Motion Star
metallicitySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of HD 307842 (pscomppars): [Fe/H] -0.13 dex, from Hua et al. 2023 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023AJ....166...32H/abstract)
luminositySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of HD 307842 (pscomppars): log10 of the luminosity in solar units -0.19034, from TICv8 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2019AJ....158..138S/abstract)
ageSource: Gaia DR3 FLAME (Creevey et al. 2023, A&A 674, A26), astrophysical_parameters of Gaia DR3 5251941573573934080, flags_flame 00: age_flame 0.32517046 Gyr (16th to 84th percentiles 0.2 to 1.3695245)
projectedRotationSpeedSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of HD 307842 (pscomppars): projected rotation speed 1.1 km/s, from Hua et al. 2023 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023AJ....166...32H/abstract)
